rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something physically extends from one side of a gap or space to the other.

example.english: This bridge is designed to span the entire strait.
example.traditional: 呢條橋係設計嚟橫跨成個海峽。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 kiu4 hai6 cit3 gai3 lai4 waang4 kwaa1 sing4 go3 hoi2 haap6

rows.note: Use this when stating how much area a building, site, or facility covers.

example.english: The exhibition hall is said to span tens of thousands of square feet.
example.traditional: 呢個展覽館佔地有成萬平方呎。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zin2 laam5 gun2 zim3 dei6 jau5 sing4 maan6 ping4 fong1 cek3

rows.note: Use this when something extends through several years, decades, or centuries rather than across a physical gap.

example.english: This drama series continues to span three generations.
example.traditional: 呢套劇集跨越三個世代。
example.jyutping: nei1 tou3 kek6 zaap6 kwaa1 jyut6 saam1 go3 sai3 doi6
